about.title: Why we built Wat2Do
about.origin: Wat2Do began when we were bored, simple as that. We wanted to find things to do on campus at the University of Waterloo but had no way of seeing everything in one place. When we discovered a way to scrape events from Instagram, we knew what we had to do. Since August 2025, Wat2Do has captured more than 29,000 events from 19,600 accounts at {{count}} school.
about.belief: University is one of the best times to try something new. Clubs you didn't know existed often hold welcoming, low-cost events open to every student, from workshops and game nights to sports and more. Plenty come with free food, too. If you're looking for a j*b (sorry), there are plenty of company-sponsored events and networking nights as well.
about.problem: The problem was never that there is nothing to do. It was finding out about events after they already happened.

problem.title: Most campus events never make it to your feed.
problem.description: Clubs at {{school}} announce events on their own Instagram accounts a few days ahead, and Instagram shows each post to only some of their followers.

buried.title: Buried in your feed
buried.description: Following a club doesn't mean you see its posts. Instagram picks what reaches you, and event flyers rarely beat everything else in your feed.

scattered.title: Hundreds of clubs, no shared feed
scattered.description: Clubs, societies and teams each post on their own account. You can't follow hundreds of them, so you hear about whatever your friends happen to repost.

late.title: You find out the day after
late.description: You see the recap of a recruiter night or a free dinner and realize it was yesterday.

quiet.title: So campus feels quiet
quiet.description: With events spread over hundreds of accounts, a week can look empty even when clubs ran plenty of things.

solution.title: Wat2Do puts it all on one page and keeps it current.
solution.description: Wat2Do reads club posts at {{school}} and lists the events and open club positions it finds, usually within a day of the post. You can search and filter them and save the ones you want.

free.question: Is Wat2Do free?
free.answer: Yes. Wat2Do is free for students, and you can browse every event without an account. Sign in to turn on Notify me and get reminders.

clubs.question: Does my club need to sign up?
clubs.answer: No. If your club posts events on a public Instagram account, Wat2Do picks them up on its own. You can also claim your club's page to manage it.

speed.question: How fast do new events show up?
speed.answer: Most new events show up within 19 hours of the club posting them.

submit.question: Can I add an event myself?
submit.answer: Yes. Submit it from the events page. Upload the poster and Wat2Do fills in the details for you.
